correctness.rationale: For k>=4 the norm-one circle has 2^{k+1} points. Reduction modulo M=2^{k-1} has four lifts per element and is parameterized without overlap as i^j(1+2iz)/(1-2iz), j=0..3 and z modulo 2^{k-3}. Converting the difference energy to Re((s-1)(w-1))=0 mod M gives a ten-type orientation valuation table; only nine ordered orientations contribute, with Tprime=3*n*2^{n+1}+6*2^n=6(n+1)2^n, n=k-3. Multiplication by |C| and the 16 lifts yields E=3(k-2)2^{2k+3}. Orthogonality supplies unweighted Fourier fourth moment. Independent direct convolution checks through k=7 and angular incidence counts support, not replace, the valuation proof.
